name: squareline-design-tools
description: Asset + font toolchain for the SquareLine watch-UI pipeline (PNG via resvg+lucide, LVGL fonts via lv_font_conv).
//: node_modules is vendored offline. `npm install` only ever fetches the binding for the CURRENT machine, so a Windows-built tree dies on Linux with 'Cannot find module @resvg/resvg-js-linux-x64-gnu'. Use `python tools/vendor_prepare.py --prune-lucide` instead: it side-loads every platform binding (plus the resvg-wasm fallback) and prunes lucide-static's unused font/dist trees (~46 MB).
